subject.title: Allow multiple account in the status bar for same provider.

question: Should CodexBar implement the accepted selected-account status-item mode now, or keep this issue deferred while Phase 1 claude-swap menu-card support settles?
rationale: Current main has the model foundation but not the requested status-bar behavior, and the documented remaining work changes status-item identity, Merge Icons semantics, persisted UI behavior, and privacy/auth presentation.

options.title: Implement accepted selected-account mode
options.body: Build the documented opt-in replacement mode with account identity, migration, privacy, ordering, and Merge Icons conflict handling.

options.title: Keep deferred
options.body: Leave this issue open as a product follow-up while collecting feedback on the newly merged claude-swap account-card foundation.

options.title: Reconsider additive account toggles
options.body: Reopen the alternative where selected accounts add extra items while the provider item remains, accepting the added duplicate-item and Merge Icons design work.

recommendation.title: Implement accepted selected-account mode
recommendation.body: Build the documented opt-in replacement mode with account identity, migration, privacy, ordering, and Merge Icons conflict handling.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the accepted architecture and explicitly framed the remaining status-item behavior as a product choice.
